title: The river pottery school
alt: An open-air pottery school stretches along a narrow river in warm afternoon light.
description: A coherent architectural visualization arranges workspaces, ceramic objects and a riverside garden.
prompt: A detailed architectural visualization of an open-air pottery school beside a narrow river. One long timber roof supported by dark columns shelters a continuous row of pottery workbenches; clay vessels, shelves and several empty stools are arranged coherently. A low stone wall separates the terrace from the water, and a small footbridge connects to a planted garden on the opposite bank. Soft late-afternoon light, rich natural wood and ceramic textures, no people or writing.
